name: Dinosaur Rock
description: Locke, who is ferocious in nature and large in size, is aloof and unfettered by any orders, and despises all weaklings and authority. Locke's bravery and strength are astonishing. His strong and hard body is the main source of his powerful combat power. His strong head and horns can break through any architectural obstacles. All hard things can be easily torn apart by Locke's sharp teeth. Locke's thick mecha is indestructible and can fight in various terrains such as underwater, swamps, and jungles.
